name: publicWeb_getGlobalCalendar
description: Returns one row per (local event date, kennel) for every live kennel with visible, live runs in a date window, for the global run calendar with load-more paging. Dates are the kennel-local EventStartLocalDate (persisted, served by the filtered index IX_Event_LocalDate_Visible). Kennels without a KennelWebsite row are included with a NULL colour; the frontend falls back to an initial-letter placeholder. No authentication. Read-only.

parameters.name: fromDate
parameters.description: Start date (inclusive). Defaults to today (UTC) if NULL.

parameters.name: daysLimit
parameters.description: Number of days to include (default 30, clamped to 1–365).

rowsets.name: Sentinel
rowsets.description: Always returns a single row (CalendarAvailable = 1) so the shim does not emit HTTP 404 when the calendar window has no events. An empty window is a valid response, not a missing resource.

rowsets.name: CalendarRows
rowsets.description: One row per (EventStartLocalDate, kennel) — GROUP BY collapses a kennel's several runs on one day; ORDER BY EventDate, KennelName. Empty = no runs in the window.

columns.name: EventDate
columns.description: HC.Event.EventStartLocalDate — the kennel-local date of the run (persisted computed column).

columns.name: KennelSlug
columns.description: URL slug (Kennel.KennelUniqueShortName). Used to build the kennel homepage URL.

columns.name: KennelName
columns.description: Full kennel name for display and alt text.

columns.name: KennelLogo
columns.description: Logo URL from HC.Kennel.KennelLogo (NOT NULL). May be a bundle:// ref (e.g. 'bundle://defaultKennelLogo') — caller must check for https:// prefix before rendering as an image.

columns.name: PrimaryColor
columns.description: CSS hex colour from HC.KennelWebsite.PrimaryColor. Used as the background for the logo placeholder when no valid image URL is available.

columns.name: PublicKennelId
columns.description: Public kennel GUID. Used as a stable React list key.

columns.name: EventNumber
columns.description: MIN(Event.EventNumber) of the kennel's runs that day — the run-detail link target (/{slug}/{EventNumber}).

rowsets.name: CatchEnvelope
rowsets.description: On a runtime error (CATCH, line 88): { Success = 0, ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE() }, possibly after rowsets already sent. NOT logged to HC.ErrorLog and not re-raised.

codeSmells.issue: CATCH does not log to HC.ErrorLog
codeSmells.detail: The CATCH (lines 87-89) returns { Success = 0, ErrorMessage } without writing HC.ErrorLog and without THROW, so a timeout or bad input surfaces to the shim as a data rowset and leaves no server-side record (CLAUDE.md 'Every CATCH must log'). The sentinel row may already have been sent.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never remove the sentinel rowset (rowset 0) — callers rely on it to distinguish empty-window from error
